notes: The two ends of the track are about 460 km apart by road. Arrange your transport before you go.
Mountain bikes can use the track from 1 May to 30 November.
The coast between Heaphy Hut and Kōhaihai has strong waves. Do not swim. In heavy seas, wait for a lower tide at Crayfish Point.
Sandflies are bad on the coast. Use repellent.

pois.name: Gouland Downs
pois.text: Open tussock country with limestone caves and arches near the hut. Takahē live here: stay 20 m away from them.
